$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. LoopInstallation = the phone-local durable record of one package's journey through the eleven-state import/activation machine (docs/ratified/loops/LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §3, FB-RAT-IMP-001/007), from ACQUIRING through INSTALLED or one of the five terminal states. The `installationState` enum below is copied VERBATIM from that document's §3 — do not re-derive or approximate it; a conflict between this schema's enum and that document's table is this schema's error, and the document wins. `signatureState` is copied verbatim from docs/ratified/loops/LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11's signature verification/revocation state table, for the same reason.
title: LoopInstallation
description: The local record of a verified (or in-progress, or rejected) LoopPackage on this phone. One LoopInstallation exists per import attempt, created at ACQUIRING and updated in place as the underlying attempt advances through docs/ratified/loops/LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §3's state machine — the record's OWN mutation is expected (it is a live session object), which is a different invariant from the one below about the PACKAGE BYTES it references. INVARIANT (documented, not structurally enforceable by JSON Schema — this schema cannot see a prior version of the same document to compare against): once `installationState` reaches `INSTALLED`, the installed package bytes identified by `releaseIdentity.packageContentDigest` are immutable (LOOP-ID-002, loop-validation-rules.v1.json) — a subsequent edit MUST fork a new local draft (a new, separate LoopInstallation lineage) rather than rewrite this record's `releaseIdentity` in place. Fields this schema deliberately leaves as forward pointers to sibling WP-1L schemas rather than inlining their full shape: `compatibilityReportRef`/`bindingProfileRef` point at loop-compatibility-report.schema.json / binding-profile.schema.json documents stored as their own durable objects, not embedded here.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH of this record's shape. A reader MUST reject an unrecognized MAJOR (FB-RAT-COM-003).

installationId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this installation record (FB-RAT-COM-002), stable across every state transition of the same import attempt.

releaseIdentity.description: {loopId, semanticVersion, packageContentDigest} — LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §14's release identity tuple. This is the byte-identity the immutability invariant above is anchored to.

source.description: The user-initiated transfer envelope this installation began from (schemas/loops/transfer-envelope.schema.json, LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §21) — file, share-sheet, HTTPS URL, QR, or Git. Duplicated locally per this corpus's standalone-schema convention rather than cross-file $ref'd.

signatureState.description: Where this attempt sits in LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11's signature verification/revocation state table. Null only before the CONTAINER_VERIFIED transition has run (signature verification is part of that transition, LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §3) — see the allOf below for what installationState requires of this field.

compatibilityReportRef.description: Pointer to the loop-compatibility-report.schema.json document this attempt's COMPATIBILITY_EVALUATED transition produced (docs/ratified/loops/LOOP_COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md, FB-RAT-CMP-005 — the phone-authoritative report). Null before that transition has run.

bindingProfileRef.description: Pointer to the binding-profile.schema.json document this attempt's binding resolution (LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §5) produced — the local, device-specific resolution of this package's abstract slots. Null before binding resolution completes (i.e. while still in WAITING_BINDINGS).

authorityGrants.description: Grant IDs (schemas/authority/grant.schema.json Grant.grantId — the WP-1 authority domain) issued during this attempt's WAITING_AUTHORITY review (LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §6). Referenced by ID only, not embedded — the authority domain owns the full Grant shape; this array MUST NOT be treated as authoritative evidence of what a grant actually authorizes without resolving each ID against the Grant store.

installationState.description: THE MOST IMPORTANT FIELD. Exactly the eleven ordered states plus five terminal states LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §3 resolves the pack's two colliding draft state machines into — copied verbatim, not re-derived.

receipts.description: Append-only list of per-transition receipt refs (FB-RAT-COM-006, LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §3's 'Receipt' column) — the lightweight per-step events plus, on reaching INSTALLED, the full loop-activation-receipt.schema.json document. A correction is a NEW entry appended here, never an edit or removal of an existing one.

createdAtUtc.description: UTC instant this record was created, i.e. when the ACQUIRING transition happened (FB-RAT-COM-004).

updatedAtUtc.description: UTC instant of the most recent state transition. Null only for a record still exactly at ACQUIRING with no further transition yet.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

allOf.$comment: FB-RAT-IMP-009: an INSTALLED record MUST have a resolved compatibility report, a resolved binding profile, a settled (non-transient) signature posture, and at least one receipt (the activation receipt this transition itself writes).

A compatibility report is produced by the COMPATIBILITY_EVALUATED transition and exists at or after that point on the main path, or at the one terminal state reachable specifically from that range (BLOCKED_INCOMPATIBLE, §3).

initiatedByUser.description: FB-RAT-IMP-002: there is no representable false state — a transfer that was not user-initiated MUST NOT be represented by this object at all.

objectId.description: The referenced document's own FB-RAT-COM-002 stable ID (its `reportId`/`profileId`/`receiptId`, as appropriate to what is being pointed at).

digest.description: Optional integrity binding to the exact referenced document bytes at the time this ref was recorded (FB-RAT-COM-005). Null when the reference is a live pointer rather than a pinned snapshot.

PackageSignatureState.description: Copied verbatim from LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11's from-state/event/to-state/notes table. `PACKAGE_ACQUIRED` is the pre-branch state (present only transiently; a real installation record's non-null signatureState has already branched past it).

InstallationState.description: The first eleven values are the main-path sequence (LOOP_IMPORT_ACTIVATION_CONTRACT.md §3, ACQUIRING through INSTALLED, in order); the last five are the terminal states reachable from various points along that path (§3's terminal-states table): CANCELLED and FAILED_SAFE from any non-terminal state; REJECTED_UNSAFE from ACQUIRING..CONTAINER_VERIFIED; REJECTED_POLICY from CONTAINER_VERIFIED..WAITING_AUTHORITY; BLOCKED_INCOMPATIBLE from PARSED_VALIDATED..COMPATIBILITY_EVALUATED. Copied verbatim from that document's resolution of the pack's two colliding draft state machines — do not re-derive or approximate.
